03 / A CLEAR PROCESS

Small rules. Visible reasoning.

1. Find explicit commitments

Action markers, checkboxes, action verbs and named commitments become suggestions. No hidden model or paid service.

2. Keep uncertainty visible

Missing owners, ambiguous dates and blockers stay visible. “Tomorrow” uses the date of its source, never a guess.

3. Make it yours

Edit, confirm, dismiss or finish each step. Export a plan with quotes, or save a workspace to resume later.

Built for small teams who need a clear meeting follow-up.AI-assisted development · No AI inference at runtime · MIT
